description: Use this when the connected learner asks about their CertArc progress. Returns aggregate sprint progress, the target exam date and days to the exam, and the learner's access (Paid, Trial or None and the day it ends) for one certification. Never prices or payments; never for another person.

program.description: Certification to read. Omit for the one the learner studied most recently; every result names its certification and lists the learner's others.

name: get_study_summary
title: Study progress
